name: My Siren Crush
source:
Dive under the sea and let your heart be swept away by the merperson of your dreams! The ocean has been calling to you since you were young, but there is more to be discovered hiding under the waves than you could ever imagine. Are you ready to play as the heroine, have fun in the sun, and believe? Dive into a magical world of merfolk, adventure, and maybe even find love!

[From in-app description]
translation:
潜入海底，让梦中的人鱼俘获你的心吧！从小到大，大海一直在呼唤你，而波涛之下藏着的秘密，远比你想象的更多。准备好化身女主角，享受阳光，怀抱对奇迹的信念了吗？跃入这个充满人鱼与冒险的魔法世界，说不定还能邂逅爱情！

[摘自应用内简介]
